knownGaps.rationale: Aurelia executes arbitrary IAttrMapper.useTwoWay predicates against the live element. Semantic-runtime now rejects partially understood predicate conjunctions instead of widening them, but does not yet preserve an executable or open predicate product, so the valid live-attribute branch remains conservatively to-view.

Unknown listener events fall back to the generic CustomEvent declaration but project its unbound type parameter as CustomEvent<T>. The public cursor type should instantiate the unproven detail payload as unknown rather than leaking a declaration-local type variable or widening it to any.

Attribute-name completion has no ref-target site/candidate vocabulary. It cannot distinguish special ref API targets from same-node resource controllers without rebuilding the runtime ref relation in a local completion island.
Attribute-name completion does not expose an event-target context backed by DOM event maps and an honest custom-event fallback, so trigger/capture target completion is absent.

The parser and lowered instruction now preserve exact modifier text and source, but completion lacks an event-family/registered-service modifier candidate kind and therefore cannot offer prevent, stop, or keyboard modifiers honestly.

Aurelia creates each SpreadValueBinding only when the runtime source is a non-null object and the bindable property key is present. Semantic-runtime currently emits every target bindable as an ordinary flow, loses the non-null member shape of nullable sources, and invents missing-member flows for absent and primitive keys instead of distinguishing potential target enumeration from conditional runtime realization.

Aurelia executes a custom element's capture predicate for each non-bindable attribute. Semantic-runtime preserves an exact open seam for the callable boundary but does not yet execute or project the known predicate, so it cannot reject class while admitting data-note into dynamic spread compilation.

Local-template materialization preserves the exact authored mode token and selected bindable, but the metadata is removed before ordinary HTML value-site classification and completion has no local-template bindable-mode site or candidate vocabulary. The completion lane must consume that shared declaration product rather than reparsing the stripped metadata.
